description:
Amendment 0001 is issued to inform all offerors to the following information:

All Questions / Requests for Information for the Triennial Electrical Inspection shall be submitted electronically to

Brian Kish; Email:  Brian.Kish@va.gov.  Questions / Requests for Information due date March 26, 2026, 10:00 A.M. EST.

Proposal Due Date remains March 31, 2026, 10:00 a.m. EST.  Proposals shall be submitted to Brian Kish;

Email:  Brian.Kish@va.gov.     

All other Terms and Conditions remain unchanged
